parameters.title: ME6 bag feeding and opening station
notes: Proposed compact station; no automatic bag replenishment, filling, sealing, or bag removal is animated.
Flattened bag depth and magazine capacity are provisional; measure actual bags.
Bag deformation is illustrative. URDF joint limits and TCP pose residuals are checked; full mesh collision, dynamics and paper/vacuum behaviour are not validated.
